main_text.p: בְּרִיךְ Ch. & Syr. Benedictus. Plur. בְּרִיכִין. Fœminin. בְּרִיכָא, emph. בְּרִיכְתָא Benedicta. Plur. בְּרִיכָן.
בְּרְכְתָא, בְּרְכָא Ch. ܒܪܟܬܐ Syr. Benedictio. Plural.
בְּרָךְ Ch. ܒܪܟ Syr. Genu. Plur. cum affix.
בִּרְכּוֹהִי Genua fua, Daniel. 6. 11. Syr. ܒܪܟܘܗܝ, Matth. 17. 14.

בְּרִילבִּירוּלָא בְּרִלָא, בְּרִלָא, בּוּרְלָא Ch. Beryllus: vel Onychinus juxta alios. Nomen lapidis pretiosi. Plur. בִּירוּלִין Berylli, Jobi 28. 16. In Targ. Jonathanis Numer. 2. 25. Jon. legitur בִּרְלוּת חַלָּא, itidem pro gemma quadam.
בְּרָםCh. & Syr. Tantùm, Tantummodo, Duntaxat: Verùm, Verumtamen, Sed, Profecto, Certò, Verè, Utique, Omnino.
בְּרַןבִּירָן & בִּירַנְתָּא, Esth. 1. 2. 5. Palatium, Basilica. Plur. בְּרַנְיָתָא, בְּרַנִין.
בּוּרְנִי Ch. Liburna, Liburnica, genus navigiorum, Jesa. 33. 21. Forte corruptum est ex integro לְבַרְנֵיא: Vel deductum à Graeco βάεις, Navis, Navigium, voce Ionica.
בּוּרְנִיתָא Ch. pro Hebraeo יָמִים Muli, Genes. 36. 24. in Targ. Jonath.
בָּרַסCh. Rudere. Aphel Partic. מְרוֹרָא Ut rudat onager, Job. 6. 5. Hebr. נָהַק.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac type is transcribed as closely as the scan allows; several vocalised forms and Syriac words are approximate. Marginal headwords at left are small bold Hebrew entries; their exact vocalisation is uncertain. The Syriac word at the foot right is partly illegible.
